newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FJ Benjamin unit buys Hong Kong office.
newsitem.headline: FJ Benjamin unit buys Hong Kong office.

text.p: FJ Benjamin Holdings Ltd said on Monday its subsidiary, FJ Benjamin Fashions (HK) Ltd, had agreed to buy office space from Swire and Island Communication Developments Ltd for Hong Kong $173,708,800 in cash.

It said in a statement part of the 21,184 square foot office space in Hong Kong's Island Place Tower would serve as the corporate office for its subsidiaries FJ Benjamin (HK) and BMI (Hong Kong) Ltd, while the rest would be leased at market rates.
A 10 percent cash deposit had been paid on February 14 and the purchase was expected to be completed by August 31, it said.

The acquisition would be financed by bank borrowings and was not expected to have any material impact on the net tangible assets and earnings per share of the company for the year ending June 30, 1997, the statement said.
